123: The lender says five years etc. - This is another case. A lender and borrower who come to court, the lender claims (says) [the land] is mortgaged to me for five years, and the document is not before us, the borrower claims (says) three years and you (the lender) have finished (consumed) your three years:

Since he could have claimed (said) it is in my hands as a result of a purchase - Outright (purchase for evermore), and I have occupied (consumed) the [three] years of (required), that establish [ownership for which thereafter no documentary proof is required] and I have lost my document:
